title: Choose the Pak Hub workbench
question: Which layout should Pak Hub use? All three keep your DRG-inspired mining-terminal direction and White Rabbit typeface. Choose one, or tell me what you would combine or change.

options.label: Manifest bench
options.lineage: A mine-operations manifest with a standing inspector
options.thesis: Keep filters, the archive, and the selected release visible together.
options.viewport: A narrow filter rail, a broad result ledger, and a quiet release dossier share one working surface.
options.risk: The always-visible dossier leaves less width for the archive on smaller screens.

options.label: Archive ledger
options.lineage: A mine inventory ledger built for scanning
options.thesis: Let the whole archive read as one ordered list, then open a release in place.
options.viewport: Search and category controls lead into a full-width ledger; the selected row opens its version and variant controls below.
options.risk: Opening a long release history pushes the remaining rows down the page.

options.label: Two-pane workbench
options.lineage: A compact mod roster beside a release workbench
options.thesis: Use a short mod index to keep the selected release and download controls spacious.
options.viewport: Search and filters sit above a compact selectable roster and a wider version-history dossier.
options.risk: A dense roster needs a clear selected state and a good mobile reflow.
